vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.description: Vendor names, e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, GitHub, AWS, Google Cloud, Slack, Cloudflare, Vercel, Datadog, Twilio, Shopify, Zoom. Leave empty (and categories empty) to watch all 134.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Watch whole groups: ai, cloud, devtools, observability, collaboration, marketing-sales, support, commerce, payments-finance, hr, security-identity.

customStatusPages.title: Other status pages
customStatusPages.description: Any status page run on Atlassian Statuspage, e.g. https://status.example.com. Most SaaS status pages are.

minImpact.title: Minimum impact
minImpact.description: Skip incidents below this impact. none includes maintenance-style notices.

onlyChanges.title: Only changes since the last run
onlyChanges.description: On: each run returns incidents that are new, escalated or resolved since the previous run, for alerts on a schedule. Off: every incident in the window, for outage history.

lookbackHours.title: Lookback window (hours)
lookbackHours.description: With changes on, how far back the first run reaches (open incidents are always included). With changes off, the history window. Status pages keep their latest 50 incidents.

includeUpdateText.title: Include latest update text
includeUpdateText.description: The vendor's most recent message on the incident.
